items.label: 15° to 25° latitude
items.quote: Moist tropical climates extend north and south from the equator to about 15° to 25° latitude.

items.label: 64°F (18°C)
items.quote: In these climates, all months have average temperatures greater than 64°F (18°C) and annual precipitation greater than 59".

items.label: warm to cool summers and cold winters
items.quote: Moist continental mid-latitude climates have warm to cool summers and cold winters.

items.label: 50°F (10°C)
items.quote: The average temperature of the warmest month is greater than 50°F (10°C), while the coldest month average temperature is less than 27°F (-3°C).

items.label: year-round cold temperatures
items.quote: Polar climates have year-round cold temperatures, with the warmest month less than 50°F (10°C).

items.label: Greenland and Antarctica
items.quote: Polar climates are found on the northern coastal areas of North America, Europe, Asia, and on the land masses of Greenland and Antarctica.

checks.message: every sort text length, id pattern and id uniqueness is within the frozen limits
all 6 item quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quotes-verbatim)

every item label occurs in its quote and every group label occurs in the quote or the same source paragraph (item-and-group-in-quote; the design discloses the weak-link false accept on long paragraphs — every quote is shown to the teacher)
every declared group is referenced by >= 2 items and every item groupId resolves (groups-covered)
every item has a distinct label after normalisation (distinct-items)
groups 3 (2-4) and items 6 (6-12) are within the frozen counts (counts-valid)
every number in group and item labels appears on the cited page or in the same quote (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
